body: The conservative case for NATO is not that it strengthens liberal world order. Rather, the conservative case for
is that it bolsters American national interests. In an age of great-power competition, as identified by the Trump administration,
. The United States, Canada, and their European allies have a number of common interests and common challenges
with regard to Beijing, Moscow, terrorism, cyberattacks, migration, nuc
s, and military readiness. NATO is the one
alliance that allows for cooperation on these
matters. It is also the only alliance that embodies America’s civilizational ties
with Europe — a point forcefully made by President Trump when he visited Poland in 2017. Properly understood,
strategic competitors at bay, pushing back on Russian and Chinese influence
. In all of these ways, the U.S. alliance system in Europe is a bit like oxygen. You may take it for granted, but you’ll miss it when it’s gone.
